rationale: All four prior blocking findings (CR-001..CR-004) are resolved on current source: last-page SQL, cache-key and branch-ranking SQL are now pinned by tests, the branches SQL moved to branch_page_sql.py, and the two-project and non-super-admin /repositories tests exist. findings.title: Last-page SQL and cache key unpinned by tests
findings.problem: The condition returning unattributed session ids only on the last page is not asserted (tests check only the column alias and the NULL project condition). No test asserts branch_unattributed changes dashboard_key or the reader sel key.
findings.impact: Changing >= or dropping the condition, or dropping the cache-key line, would show the Unattributed row on every page or serve cached responses across scopes with no test failing. Reachability confirmed only via test grep.
findings.recommendation: Assert the offset+limit >= count(projects) condition in the unsearched SQL and ARRAY[]::text[] for the searched one; assert dashboard_key differs for branch_unattributed True vs False.
findings.check_notes: test_reader asserts last-page condition and ARRAY[] for searched page; dashboard_key and _sel_key tests cover branch_unattributed

fix.change: Added tests pinning the last-page unattributed-ids condition, the searched empty array, and branch_unattributed in sel key and dashboard_key

findings.title: Branch ranking SQL has no SQL-level test
findings.problem: get_branch_ranking is exercised only by statement-count tests, signature parity and AsyncMock handler tests. NULL-branch ordering, the page filter, count FILTER, selp restriction and facts join are never asserted; the aggregating test support does not cover it.
findings.impact: A regression would ship wrong rows or total_count on GET /branches with no failing test.
findings.recommendation: Add a reader SQL-recorder test or live-DB aggregate test asserting NULL group ordering, the 'branch IS NULL OR (rn ...)' page filter, count(*) FILTER (WHERE branch IS NOT NULL) and that the NULL group returns its sessions' facts.
findings.check_notes: test_reader SQL-recorder test asserts NULL ordering, page filter, count FILTER, selp and facts join; strings present in branch_page_sql.py

fix.change: Added SQL-recorder test for get_branch_ranking: NULL-branch ordering, page filter, selp, count FILTER, facts join

findings.title: Branches SQL bloats reader.py
findings.problem: code-quality Module Cohesion: the paged branches query and SQL (~100 lines) were appended to the 3727-line reader.py instead of a sibling module like project_page_sql.py or session_page_sql.py.
findings.impact: The documented code-quality standard is blocking and is only partially met.
findings.recommendation: Extract the branches page SQL and its helpers into a new module next to project_page_sql.py and import it from reader.py.
findings.check_notes: branch ranking SQL moved to branch_page_sql.py, imported by reader.py

fix.change: Moved branch ranking SQL into postgres/branch_page_sql.py; reader.py calls branch_ranking_sql

findings.title: AC-B3/AC-B9 required tests missing
findings.problem: The spec requires /repositories?projects=P to be tested with two projects sharing a repository, and the non-super-admin result pinned. Neither exists; the /repositories test only checks is_project_unattributed is forwarded to resolve, and the empty-200 case is pinned for /branches only.
findings.impact: Required acceptance criteria are partially unmet; project-scoped metrics and the access outcome for /repositories are unpinned.
findings.recommendation: Add a /repositories?projects=P test with two projects sharing a repository asserting P-only metrics, and a test pinning empty 200 for a non-super-admin with is_project_unattributed.
findings.check_notes: new router test file covers two-project shared repository and non-super-admin empty 200 on /repositories

fix.change: Added /repositories router tests: shared repository counts only selected project sessions; non-super-admin unattributed gets empty 200
